hero.description: We are ArTours, a local travel coordinate team passionate about sharing the living history and soul of Armenia with the world. Our mission is to bridge cultures by providing deeply authentic, safe, and friendly travel experiences that directly support native host communities. Through carefully crafted itineraries, certified mountain coordinates, and warm local guides, we connect curious explorers with the ancient monasteries, spectacular volcanic highlands, and legendary hospitality of our home.

director.story: Barev dzez and welcome! My name is Artur. I am a certified driver-guide, originally from Gyumri, and I have been living in Yerevan for many years. I truly love connecting with people, which is why I dedicated my life to tourism back in 2017. For me, every tour is not just a drive, but an opportunity to introduce my guests to the authentic Armenia—its rich history, ancient culture, picturesque nature, and genuine hospitality. My main goal is to make every traveler feel comfortable and safe, and to ensure they take home the warmest memories. I strive to create an atmosphere where each excursion is not only informative but also lighthearted, soulful, and filled with bright emotions. The greatest reward for me is when guests say, "We will definitely come back to Armenia again." It is for the sake of these unforgettable impressions that I gladly welcome every traveler.

land.description: More than a travel destination, Armenia is an emotional journey back in time. Nestled in the high-altitude crossroads of the South Caucasus, this sacred landscape unfolds a living tapestry of ancient traditions, dramatic natural wonders, and legendary hospitality.

history.title: Ancient History & Culture
history.subtitle: Cradle of Civilization
history.desc: Armenia is one of the world's oldest civilizations, home to the Areni-1 winery dating back 6,100 years. Explore ancient stone carvings and living history written in volcanic stone.

mountains.title: Caucasus Mountains & Landscapes
mountains.subtitle: Monoliths of Stone
mountains.desc: Gaze upon the majestic silhouette of Mount Ararat, traverse the dramatic volcanic cliffs of Garni Gorge, and admire the basalt columns of the Symphony of Stones. Armenia's rugged highlands are an alpine masterpiece carved by geological time.

sevan.title: Lake Sevan & Blue Waters
sevan.subtitle: The Blue Eye of Armenia
sevan.desc: Suspended at 1,900 meters above sea level, Lake Sevan is a breathtaking high-altitude freshwater gem. Ringed by wind-swept mountains, its changing sapphire waters create a stunning alpine retreat.

hiking.title: Forests & Monastic Trails
hiking.subtitle: Pathways of the Soul
hiking.desc: Hike through the lush, misty woods of Dilijan National Park—Armenia's Switzerland. Follow scenic trails along rushing rivers and hidden forest waterfalls.

hospitality.title: Hospitality & Gastronomy
hospitality.subtitle: Warmth in Every Home
hospitality.desc: Experience legendary hospitality where guests are welcomed like family. Taste flatbread (lavash) baked in clay tandoors (tonir), organic cheeses, mountain herbs, and premium wines aged in ancient Areni caves.

explore.description: Let our expert local guides craft a journey tailored just for you — private tours, custom itineraries, or handpicked excursions through Armenia's most breathtaking landscapes.

faq.description: Everything you need to know about traveling in Armenia with ArTours (artours.am).

items.q: What are the best tours in Armenia and day trips from Yerevan?
items.a: Top day tours from Yerevan include Garni Pagan Temple & Geghard Monastery, Lake Sevan & Dilijan National Park, Khor Virap Monastery with Mount Ararat views, and private tours to Tatev Cable Car.

items.q: How to book a trip to a location from Yerevan?
items.a: You can easily book your trip to any curated location online at ArTours (artours.am). Our professional driver meets you with a comfortable vehicle and provides direct transportation to any destination in Armenia.

items.q: Why choose ArTours for tours and locations in Armenia?
items.a: ArTours is an official tour brand in Armenia. We provide certified local driver-guides, comfortable AC vehicles, transparent pricing, and customizable private tour packages.

items.q: What are the top things to do and places to visit in Armenia?
items.a: Must-see highlights include Yerevan city sights, Garni, Geghard, Lake Sevan, Noravank Monastery, Wings of Tatev, Dilijan, Jermuk waterfalls, and Echmiadzin Mother Cathedral.

sections.title: 1. General Provisions
paragraphs: These Terms and Conditions govern the use of the ArTours website (artours.am) and the booking of tours and transfer services through the website.
By accessing the website or making a booking, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the website or its services.
ArTours provides information about tours, transportation, and related travel services in Armenia. Service descriptions, prices, itineraries, and conditions may vary depending on the selected service.

sections.title: 2. Bookings and Confirmations
paragraphs: Customers may submit booking requests through the ArTours website by providing accurate and complete information.

A booking request is considered confirmed only after confirmation from ArTours. Customers are responsible for checking the booking details, including the date, time, number of passengers, pickup location, destination, and selected services.
ArTours reserves the right to decline or cancel a booking when a service is unavailable, operational limitations arise, safety concerns occur, or incorrect information has been provided.

sections.title: 3. Prices and Payments
paragraphs: Prices are displayed on the website or communicated to the customer before the booking is confirmed.
The applicable price and any additional fees are communicated before the customer confirms the booking. Additional services or changes requested by the customer may incur extra charges.
Payment methods and deadlines are communicated during the booking process or in the booking confirmation. Customers must pay the agreed amount according to the applicable booking conditions.

sections.title: 4. Cancellations and Changes
paragraphs: Customers may request to cancel or modify a booking by contacting ArTours through the available contact channels.

Cancellation requests should be submitted at least 48 hours before the scheduled service. Later requests are subject to availability and the cancellation conditions communicated for the specific booking.
Changes to dates, times, itineraries, passenger numbers, or pickup locations are subject to availability and may affect the price.
If ArTours must cancel a confirmed service, it will inform the customer as soon as reasonably possible and explain the available alternatives or applicable refund arrangements.
Refunds and cancellation charges are governed by the conditions communicated for the booking and applicable law.

sections.title: 5. Customer Responsibilities
paragraphs: Customers agree to observe the following responsibilities throughout their experience:
items: Provide accurate contact and booking information.
Arrive at the agreed pickup location on time.
Follow reasonable safety instructions provided by guides and drivers.
Respect local laws, cultural sites, other travelers, and service personnel.
Inform ArTours in advance of relevant accessibility requirements or special arrangements.
Ensure that all passengers have the documents required for their planned travel.
sections.closingParagraph: ArTours may refuse service if a customer's behavior creates a safety risk, seriously disrupts the service, or violates applicable law.

sections.title: 6. Tours and Transportation
paragraphs: Tour itineraries, schedules, and travel times may be approximate, as circumstances can affect them.

Routes, schedules, or activities may change because of weather, road conditions, traffic, government restrictions, site closures, safety concerns, or other circumstances beyond ArTours' reasonable control.
ArTours will make reasonable efforts to inform customers of significant changes and, where possible, offer a suitable alternative.
Customers must follow the instructions of guides and drivers and comply with applicable transportation and safety requirements.

sections.title: 7. Liability and Unforeseen Circumstances
paragraphs: ArTours will make reasonable efforts to provide services as described and with appropriate care.

To the extent permitted by applicable law, ArTours is not responsible for delays, interruptions, or losses caused by circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including severe weather, natural disasters, road closures, strikes, government measures, or other force majeure events.
Nothing in these Terms and Conditions excludes or limits liability where such exclusion or limitation is prohibited by law.

sections.title: 8. Website Content and Intellectual Property
paragraphs: Website text, photographs, graphics, branding, and other materials are owned by ArTours or used with permission, unless otherwise stated.
You may not reproduce, distribute, modify, or commercially use website content without appropriate authorization.
ArTours makes reasonable efforts to keep website information accurate and current but does not guarantee that every description, photograph, price, or schedule will always be complete or error-free.

sections.title: 9. Personal Data and Privacy
paragraphs: ArTours values the privacy and security of your personal data.
Personal information you provide through our website is used to manage bookings, provide our services, communicate with you, respond to inquiries, and ensure the proper functioning of the website.
We do not sell your personal data or share it with third parties for their own marketing purposes or for purposes unrelated to our services.

To operate the website, analyze visitor statistics, and store and display images, we may use third-party services, including Google Analytics, Cloudinary, and hosting providers. These services may process certain technical or personal data to the extent necessary to perform their respective functions.
We take reasonable measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or disclosure. Data transfers and processing are carried out in accordance with applicable law.
We use your data only for the purposes described above or where required or permitted by law.

sections.title: 10. Complaints and Communication
paragraphs: Customers who have questions, concerns, or complaints about a booking should contact ArTours and provide the relevant booking details.
ArTours will make reasonable efforts to review complaints and resolve them fairly.

Changes will apply as permitted by applicable law. The terms applicable to an existing booking will be determined by the booking agreement and relevant legal requirements.

sections.title: 12. Governing Law

Any disputes will be handled by the competent courts or other appropriate dispute-resolution bodies in accordance with applicable law.

sections.title: 1. General Provisions & Data Controller
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy outlines how ArTours ('we', 'us', or 'our'), operating via artours.am, processes and safeguards the personal data of customers, website visitors, and service users.
The Data Controller responsible for the processing of your personal data under applicable legislation of the Republic of Armenia is ArTours, located in Yerevan, Armenia.
We are dedicated to respecting your privacy, protecting your personal data, and maintaining transparent practices in all data handling operations.

sections.title: 2. Personal Data We Collect
paragraphs: We collect only the personal information strictly necessary to provide our tourism, transfer, and customer support services. This data includes:
items: Contact & Identification Data: First name, last name, phone number, and email address provided during tour booking, contact inquiries, or review submission.
Booking & Travel Details: Chosen travel dates, pickup/destination locations, number of travelers, special requests, and voucher reference numbers.
User Feedback & Reviews: Rating score, review testimonial, and optional photographs you upload to share your travel experience on artours.am.
Technical & Log Data: IP address, device type, browser specifications, operating system, and pages visited, collected automatically via server logs.
sections.closingParagraph: We do not intentionally collect sensitive categories of personal data (such as racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, or religious beliefs).

sections.title: 3. Purposes of Data Processing
paragraphs: Your personal data is collected and processed for the following legitimate purposes:
items: Booking Fulfillment: Managing, scheduling, confirming, and executing tour itineraries and chauffeured transfer services.
Customer Communication: Sending booking confirmations, itinerary updates, responding to questions, and providing urgent trip support.
Authentic Reviews Display: Publishing traveler feedback and user-submitted photos on artours.am following content moderation.
Platform Security & Optimization: Monitoring website performance, detecting fraudulent activity, and refining user experience.
Legal & Regulatory Compliance: Meeting accounting, tax, transportation safety, and dispute resolution requirements under Armenian law.
sections.closingParagraph: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data with third parties for their commercial marketing purposes.

sections.title: 4. Third-Party Services & Data Processors
paragraphs: To deliver high-reliability web and travel experiences, we partner with reputable third-party service providers who process data strictly under our instructions and in compliance with security standards:
• Google Analytics (G-GRN9Q0VFPX): Measures visitor interactions, traffic channels, and usage statistics in aggregated, anonymized form.
• Cloudinary: Provides secure cloud image hosting, transformation, and fast CDN delivery for traveler photos and website visual assets.
• Telegram Bot Services: Enables optional automated notifications and trip status alerts when initiated by the customer.
• Hosting & Cloud Infrastructure: Ensures encrypted data storage, high server availability, and robust web firewall protection.
All third-party service providers are contractually obligated to maintain data confidentiality and cannot utilize your data for unauthorized purposes.

sections.title: 5. Security of Your Data
paragraphs: We implement industry-standard organizational and technical security measures to safeguard personal information against accidental loss, unauthorized access, alteration, destruction, or disclosure.

All data transmissions on artours.am are protected using modern TLS/HTTPS encryption protocols. Internal access to customer data is strictly restricted to authorized staff who require it to coordinate services.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
paragraphs: Personal data is retained only for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes for which it was gathered, including satisfying customer service requests, maintaining travel booking history, and complying with statutory fiscal retention obligations.
When personal data is no longer necessary, it is either securely deleted or irreversibly anonymized.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
paragraphs: Under applicable Armenian data protection legislation, you are entitled to exercise the following rights regarding your personal data:
items: Right of Access: Request confirmation of whether we hold your personal data and obtain a copy of such data.
Right to Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate, outdated, or incomplete personal records.
Right to Erasure ('Right to Be Forgotten'): Request deletion of your personal data where there is no longer a legal justification for its retention.
Right to Restriction of Processing: Request restriction of data processing in specified situations (e.g. while data accuracy is contested).
Right to Withdraw Consent: Withdraw consent at any time for processing activities founded on consent (such as public review display).
Right to Object: Object to processing based on legitimate business interests on grounds relating to your particular situation.
sections.closingParagraph: To exercise any of these rights, contact our team at artoursarmenia{'@'}gmail.com. We will respond without undue delay.

sections.title: 8. Policy Updates
paragraphs: We may periodically revise this Privacy Policy to reflect evolving legal standards, technical advancements, or modifications to our services.
Any revisions will be published directly on this page with an updated 'Last updated' date. We encourage users to review this page periodically.
